text: Pogačar's six-minute cushion over Evenepoel looks comfortable on paper, but Remco's late-stage aggression on the queen stage proved he's willing to exploit any weakness—and with potentially decisive terrain still ahead, UAE Team Emirates can't afford to let their leader coast. Del Toro's white jersey battle against the clock shouldn't distract from a larger tactical reality: Evenepoel has Red Bull-Bora's full squad behind him, meaning Pogačar might need to burn matches earlier than ideal to shut down coordinated attacks. Watch whether Pedersen's points lead tempts Lidl-Trek into offensive positioning that fragments the GC group, and monitor whether the crowd factor that nearly derailed Evenepoel before still poses an unpredictable wild card on any Alpine finishes.
